note.headline: Energy Surge Masks Broad Risk-Off As Crypto And Small Caps Slide
note.standfirst: Energy and materials rallied on a sharp commodity spike while breadth turned negative across the broader tape, credit softened and crypto sold off hard. Positioning into the next session hinges on whether the commodity bid is a growth signal or an inflation shock, a distinction the bond market has not yet resolved.
takeaways: Energy and materials led on a commodity spike while 17 of 26 tracked sectors and indices declined and the S&P 500 fell -0.45%.
Crypto was the single largest drag on the risk barometer, with Bitcoin down -3.02% and XRP down -9.06%.
Credit softened at the margin, with high yield, investment grade and EM sovereign debt all lower alongside a modestly flattening Treasury curve.
